{{Quote|When the speeders were pulled off the line, people started braving the deeper jungle-trying to make it to Kaas City on foot. Had a few deaths. Some of them VIPs. Captain Tolto sent us to keep people out and poke around a bit, see what's out there.|Kullin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Kullin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], guarding the entrance to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] inner jungles under orders from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tolto]].<ref name="TOR" />
